text: May make you sleepy. Do not drive if affected.
Avoid alcohol while taking this medicine.
Take with a full glass of water.
Swallow whole. Do not crush or chew.
Finish the whole course even if you feel better.
Keep in the fridge. Do not freeze.
Shake the bottle well before each use.
Avoid strong sunlight and sunbeds. Use sunscreen.
Do not stop taking this suddenly. Ask your doctor or pharmacist first.
